title: bls12-381-g1-ecdlp-plain: six-class (negation + GLV) parallel Pollard rho in G1, 128-instruction step ledger, R=2^16 twisted table, global work meter at 2^126.293

claims.statement: For a uniform challenge T=[x]P0 in BLS12-381 G1 (T=infinity returns 0), the algorithm of proof.md outputs x with success probability at least 0.39 (0.3901314), and on every run its total work is at most 2^126.293 batched-affine-G1-addition equivalents (C=2,000 instructions), enforced by a global work meter that charges every action an upper-bound price before execution and halts with failure at 2^126.293. The algorithm is parallel distinguished-point Pollard rho (2^20 walks, distinguished probability 2^-64, trail cap 20*2^64) on the (r-1)/6 = 2^252.2721269 classes of G1 under negation and phi(x,y)=(beta*x,y)=[lambda]; class key |y|; the canonical twist index is decided exactly from a 12-limb-product truncated fixed-point product with a metered exact fallback on near-ties (0.25 units); an R=2^16 twisted table makes every step one batched affine addition plus 128 instructions, so an ordinary step costs 1.064 units, a cycle-traversal step 1.076 and a doubling 1.5; 2-cycles and cycles of length <=64 are escaped by doubling the cycle's minimum 192-bit-fingerprint class (a class map; no cancellation can close a cycle through doublings since the order of 2 mod r is 2^250.8571), so trails meeting a common class reunite by the merging lemma; fresh uniform trail coefficients are stored in full and collisions are solved by re-walking with coefficients reduced mod r and x=(e_2-e_1)/(f_1-f_2) mod r verified before output. Phase 1 stops when a hard operation counter reaches S_ops=1.05*S0=2^126.19938 with S0=sqrt(2N'*ln(1/0.6095)) and N'=((r-1)/6)*2^16/(2^16-1), so heuristic H1 gives P(T_c<=S_ops)>=0.3905; phase 2 completes open trails; report capacity 2^63.25 records and 8 processed matches are caps counted as failure; the meter's early-halt probability is at most 0.000368437 by Markov at a headroom of 2^117.838, and the remaining failure events total below 1.2e-7. Peak memory is 2^70.9504 bytes (below 2^72); preprocessing (jump table 2^28, report-table initialisation 2^57.1, first 2^20 trail starts, sampling) is at most 2^57.2 units under a meter sub-cap and lies inside W; no advice is used.

experiments.purpose: Part A: on BLS12-381 G1, check the GLV pair, orbit size 6 and the unit action, the |y| class key, uniqueness of the canonical member, the truncated-product twist index against the exact rule (random and adversarial near-tie inputs), the twisted-step identity, the doubling class map, the multiplicative order of 2 mod r, table entries, coefficient tracking on production steps, and recovery of a planted x from two production trails forced to merge. Part B: run the per-trail algorithm of proof.md on a toy curve y^2=x^3+4 over F_q and report class visits to the first inter-trail collision against 1.05*sqrt(2N'*ln(1/0.6095)) and the fruitless-cycle rate; with pipeline=true the scaled production rules (phase-1 budget, phase 2, report capacity, 8-match cap) are applied and the success rate is reported; classes=1 or 2 runs control walks. The cost block prints the whole cost model of proof.md sections 3-5 from exact integers and 80-digit decimals, including the exact-integer check of the claimed score. Toy scale only.
